hero.headline: the testnet,
hero.lead: CCM Network is a carbon credit economy on Base. This page shows the entire sandbox operating in real time on Base Sepolia — open node registry, multi-oracle price consensus, NFT mints flowing into the on-chain vault, CCM staked into a finite reward pool. Every number below is fetched from the chain, not simulated.
hero.warning: ⚠ Base Sepolia testnet — tokens have no real value.

needs.title: What you'll need
needs.wallet: A wallet that supports Base Sepolia (MetaMask, Rainbow, Coinbase Wallet, etc.)
needs.network: Switch your wallet to the Base Sepolia network (chain ID 84532).
needs.gas: A small amount of Sepolia ETH for gas.
needs.faucet: Get Sepolia ETH from the Coinbase faucet

step1.title: Mine a Carbon Credit
step1.subtitle: Mint an ERC-1155 NFT that represents a tonne of CO₂ offset. Pick the grade (A is highest quality), vintage year, and tonnage. The mint contract limits you to one NFT per address per hour to keep things fair.
step1.emptyInventory: No NFTs yet. Mine your first credit above.

step2.title: Wrap NFT → CCM
step2.subtitle: Convert your carbon credit NFT into the fungible CCM token. The Vault locks the NFT as a reserve and credits you 1 CCM per tonne. You approve the Vault once, then can wrap up to 5 NFTs per transaction. Lower grades are returned first when CCM is unwrapped (D→C→B→A).

step3.title: Stake CCM
step3.subtitle: Stake your CCM into the sandbox staking contract to earn yield from a 5,000,000 CCM reward pool. The rate starts at 10% per month when the pool is fresh and decays as the pool drains and as the CCM/USD price drifts from $0.20. Approve the token once, then stake any amount.
step3.noBalance: Wrap some NFTs to get CCM first.

step4.title: Claim Reward
step4.subtitle: Reward accrues every block — the page polls the staking contract every five seconds so you can watch it grow. Claim transfers the pending CCM to your wallet. Unstaking any amount returns the principal and harvests pending reward in the same transaction.

mining.title: Mining · Network
mining.subtitle: Carbon credit mints flowing from miners into the sandbox NFT contract. Hub counter is the total CCM minted across the testnet.

oracle.title: Oracle · Consensus
oracle.subtitle: Four independent price oracles publish CCM/USD. A read-only median aggregator computes the consensus that drives the staking yield decay calculation.

yieldCurve.title: Yield · Decay
yieldCurve.subtitle: Staking yield rate decays with pool usage and CCM/USD price. R0 = 10 %/month at fresh pool and P = $0.20.

feed.subtitle: Last 10 on-chain events across mints, wraps, stakes, claims, and node registrations.
